collection.name: tOPCATs
collection.description:
tOPCATs is a 1111 piece collection of cartoon wizard cats, featuring tiered rarity, recursion, tributes, Easter eggs, 1/1s and animated pieces. all inscribed on exotic sats.

Our characters pay tribute to some of our favourite Bitcoin & Ordinals collections and entities. A playful yet purposeful nod to what makes this space special.

Owning a tOPCATs NFT is more than just art—it’s your membership pass!  Every piece grants access to our community, with future benefits & utility tiered by rarity.
